free_tier_limits.correction: The uncharged Builder tier includes 500,000 CorePlus API calls per workspace per month; calls above that limit are blocked. Core API calls are unmetered and uncharged.

rate_limits.correction: Published REST limits for sandbox and production are 500 requests per minute per realm ID and 10 requests per second per realm ID and app. Additional batch and combined-service limits also apply.

notes: The API is operational and the production host and invoice request remain current. The entry fails because Intuit now publishes both request throttles and a specific uncharged-tier allowance. Most functional description claims are supported, but the comparative claim that it is the dominant US SMB accounting platform API could not be verified from authoritative sources.
